mapper.select: select i.mi_no,i.mi_title,i.mi_reg_date,i.mi_stats,u.u_name from mukja_inquiry i LEFT JOIN users u ON i.u_no = u.u_no order by i.mi_no desc OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: update mukja_inquiry set mi_answer=#{mi_answer},mi_stats='답변완료' where mi_no=#{mi_no}
